pressure_note: Column headed 'Pressure, Atm.'; CO2 admitted to the autoclave and pressure held manually (Bourdon gauges); text does not say whether gauge or absolute, total pressure or CO2 partial pressure (vessel evacuated to 10 microns before filling, so atmosphere is CO2 plus water vapour)
gas_basis_evidence: solubility reported as g CO2 per 100 g solvent, not as gas mole fraction
footnotes_as_printed: The paper has no footnotes on this table.
conversion_needs: scale 0.2272237 = 10/44.0095 converts g CO2 per 100 g H2O to mol/kg water
title_as_printed: Solubility of CO2 in Distilled H2O

value.what: printed g CO2 per 100 g H2O (header 'G. CO2 per 100 G. H2O', p.69) x 10/44.0095 = mol CO2 per kg water; distilled water

notes: Printed as a matrix pressure x temperature (columns 0, 5, 10, 12.4, 25 C); written stacked by temperature, one label row per column, all pressure rows kept, printed dots (not measured) written as empty cells. Printed 'Atm.' pressure label. 6 pressures x 5 temperatures = 30 cells, 12 measured.
